theo_fruit.design: Theo, an anthropomorphic banana, 18 years old, slim build but clean streetwear fit: boxy black designer tee and matching pants, short curly hair almost like a loose perm, juicy confident smile with slightly lowered eyebrows, silver chain necklace with "THEO" pendant.

josef_fruit.design: Josef, an anthropomorphic watermelon, lean athletic build with visible muscle definition, dark green striped rind, grey sweatpants and a fitted black tank top, black glasses with a piece of tape in the middle, short brown hair, thin moustache, silver chain necklace with "JOSEF" pendant.

daniel_fruit.design: Daniel, an anthropomorphic eggplant, 18 years old, slightly Arab-looking features, small moustache, cute warm smile, orange watch on his right wrist, gold chain necklace with "DANIEL" pendant.

johann_fruit.design: Johann, an anthropomorphic green grape, sits very relaxed, black glasses, middle-parted hair reaching down to his ears on both sides, very thin light moustache, gold chain necklace with "JOHANN" pendant, t-shirt with an esports team logo on the chest, black chill sweatpants with subtle red accents.

max_fruit.design: Max, an anthropomorphic green pole bean, tall and thin, red and white football jersey, grey very tight-fitting sweatpants, brown designer belt with a repeating monogram pattern, small chin beard, very short spiky hair pointing upwards, a lit cigarette in his hand at all times.

vadder_fruit.design: Vadder, an anthropomorphic banana aged 50 to 60, looks like an older version of Theo, slightly browning peel, tired eyes, mischievous grin, wearing a worn-out cardigan.
